text:
maya: Deployed v1.14 to prod at 11:20 PDT. Quick sync — need to decide what gets into the next 2wk sprint. TL;DR: Acme streaming regression (high), infra cost spike investigation (med), and several low-pri UX asks. Thoughts?
deploy-bot: Deployment v1.14 succeeded: all services green. (build/4832) :rocket:
tom: Saw errors in /stream. Filed bug JIRA-423 with logs and repro: https://jira.redwood/423. Log excerpt: `socket hangup` on payloads >1MB.
jordan: Is this customer impacting? Acme reported multiple failures in prod — are they on Dedicated?
maya: @jordan yes, Acme is Dedicated + committed tier. CS on a call now (devon).
devon: On call: they see ~15% of streaming sessions fail after ~30s. We gave a temporary workaround to switch to polling. They want an ETA.
sophia: We should treat this as P0 for next sprint. Proposed scope: root cause + robust retry + monitoring/alert.
tom: I can own the fix. Plan: implement server-side chunking and limit chunk size to 512KB, tighten socket timeouts, add retry wrapper. Will have a PR by EOD.
jordan: What about the backlog UX polish items? I vote we batch low-pri stuff into v1.15 and not block this sprint.
maya: Agree. Proposed priority order: P0 = Acme streaming regression (hotfix), P1 = infra cost spike (investigate, 3d spike), P2 = UX polish (v1.15). Also decide hotfix vs normal sprint cadence.
devon: Acme requested a patch in 48-72h and asked for SLA confirmation. Recommend hotfix.
tom: Hotfix makes sense. I'll branch from prod and open a canary. @eng-oncall-bot can we get a canary window tonight?
eng-oncall-bot: Canary window requested: 20:00–22:00 PDT. Please confirm runbook and on-call.
sophia: Runbook draft: enable verbose logging on /stream, route 5% traffic to canary, watch error rate & tail logs, rollback if error rate > 2x baseline in 15min.
maya: Assigning owners: tom -> fix + PR, sophia -> canary ops, devon -> customer comms + SLA note, jordan -> backlog reprioritization doc & milestone updates.
jordan: I'll update the roadmap doc and move UX polish into v1.15 with acceptance criteria.
devon: I'll send the customer-facing note with ETA and interim polling workaround.
tom: Note: fix could surface an unrelated cache edge-case on staging. Will validate before canary.
sophia: If cache bug appears, fallback option is disabling streaming cache for the tenant until fix is verified.
maya: Ok — reconvene after canary. If hotfix is green we ship ASAP; if not, escalate to incident and we trigger a 1hr war room.
devon: :thumbsup: I'll update Acme and sync with support. Thanks everyone.
